   - To get 2 pieces of polished blackstone, we need 2 blackstone (since 1 piece of blackstone yields 1 piece of polished blackstone).

3. Gather 2 more pieces of blackstone to make a total of 6 pieces of blackstone.
4. Use 2 pieces of those 6 pieces to craft 2 polished blackstones.
5. Craft 1 polished blackstone button using the 1 polished blackstone obtained from the last step.
